name: Payday 2
texts: I will kill all of you, one by fucking one! AHHH! I- I'm just kidding! I- I scared you, didn't I?
Uh, sorry, Control. Leroy just barged in here and scared the holy shit out of me. Fuck Leroy, look where you're going, man!
I'm sorry, I just pressed the wrong- I pressed the wrong button. I- I know- I got the right one now, so... that's handy as fuck.
Fuck me, I'm hungry as hell. Anyone wanna get some burgers? I was thinking of ordering.
Yeah, yeah, that's great. Just a minute, please. Control, I must have pressed the wrong button by accident. Uh... sorry about that.
Oh, great, great, great... No, no, all good, Control! All good, I just dropped me sandwich and freaked out a bit, sorry.
No, we're good. No problem over here.
Uh, sorry lads, my bad. I thought I saw a rat. I don't like rats, they freak me out.
Not to worry lads, everything's under control.
Uh, hello. Yeah, uh, you all good over there?
I apologise, Control. I'm just, uh, tired and, uh, pressed a button by mistake. Uh, pressed this one. Oh, did it again. Sorry.
Just testing, Control. You know, checking you were there. You answered really quickly, well done, congrats, that was a very good response. Very good.
Oh. Fuck me! No, sorry lads! I think- I think I just swallowed a bug.
I just came out here to think about Bowie, you know? And just... feeling really bummed out. RIP mate.
No, it's all good, baby. Nothing to worry about. 10-4. Over and out. Roger.
Uh, honestly, I fucking wish there was some trouble, but unfortunately that's not the case.
We're fine, Control. I just wanted to talk to someone, really. Um... having some issues, you know, with a wife.
Sorry, the radio keeps acting up, lads, I can't- Hello?
Yeah, sorry boys. Cat gave me a scare. They're evil, you know? Bad luck, cats.
Any problems? No! No, not with us, no problem, all is fine and dandy. All peaceful on the Western Front, as they say.
Something's wrong with this fucking radio! No, there's no problem here. No problem at all.
Uh, nah, no, no, uh, no problem over here. Radio just, uh, must be acting up. Fucking cheap piece of shit.
False alarm, Control. Uh, just a bird came- swooped right down past me, scared the shit out of me.
No problem here, how about you guys? Any action? All's calm on my side, yeah. Nothing at all. Yeah.
Um, I apologise, Control. Just been reading, uh, King's Pet Sematary and I'm a bit freaked out, you know?
Sorry, my fault. I tried- I was trying to stand on my hands and I fell over. I'm stupid, sorry.
No, uh, j-just checking if you guys, uh... Hi guys, uh, does anybody have a deck of cards over there that we could borrow?
Oi, gents, uh... anyone else thinking of getting some pizza? I'm sorta hungry. Just wondering if anyone's ordering.
Sorry about that, Control. Don't get alarmed. It's just that we're out of milk for the coffee. I sort of lost me temper.
Okay, let's settle this once and for all, lads. Batman or Superman?
I just wanted to check if you guys wanted anything from the store. I was thinking of running down. Cigarettes, milk...
I wish there was some trouble, but this is fucking boring, mate. Nothing's happening, as usual. On patrols, you know how it goes.
You wanna hear a funny story? It's a dirty one. But it'll pass the time.
